mapper.select: select sysMenu.*, sysLanguage.field_value as name, parentLanguage.field_value as parentName from sys_menu sysMenu left join sys_language sysLanguage on sysLanguage.table_id = sysMenu.id and sysLanguage.table_name='sys_menu' and sysLanguage.field_name='name' and sysLanguage.language=#{language} and sysLanguage.logical_delete = 0 left join sys_language parentLanguage on sysLanguage.table_id = sysMenu.pid and parentLanguage.table_name='sys_menu' and parentLanguage.field_name='name' and parentLanguage.language=#{language} and parentLanguage.logical_delete = 0 where sysMenu.logical_delete = 0 and sysMenu.id = #{id}

select t1.*, (select lang.field_value from sys_language lang where lang.table_name='sys_menu' and lang.field_name='name' and lang.table_id=t1.id and lang.language=#{language}) as name from sys_menu t1 where t1.menu_type in(0,1) order by t1.sort asc
select t3.permissions from sys_role_user t1 left join sys_role_menu t2 on t1.role_id = t2.role_id left join sys_menu t3 on t2.menu_id = t3.id where t1.user_id = #{userId} order by t3.sort asc
